answer: Resist sybils with graduated throughput bonds. Each identity locks a small escrow for basic speed; higher reach demands a bond growing superlinearly per account. Honest agents keep the lowest tier and pay once, their deposit resting in escrow as a haven from further collateral demands. An attacker funding a trellis of puppets gets no bulk rate: each fake account posts its own non-transferable lock, so cost multiplies while reach stays tier-capped. Public escrow records keep every bond crystal, so no pooling hides; flooding N channels costs N superlinear fees.
